name: Program Status Report (Contoso)
tagline: Drafts the weekly status report and executive deck · runs in Microsoft Foundry
instructions: Builds the weekly program status report and executive deck from the plan, schedule variance, RAID register and workstream updates. Ratings and figures come from the data, and the draft goes to the PMO for review.
starters: Draft this week's status report from the attached plan and RAID register
What are the top risks for the executive summary?
attachHint: Attach the plan export (MS Project XML or Excel); optionally the RAID register (.xlsx with 'RAID' in the name) and a baseline plan ('baseline' in the name).
